_readme: Lines that are missing from the printed page and have been restored by hand.
The 32nd edition drops a line in two places — the gap is visible in the PDF's
own line spacing, where the leading jumps by a full line before the stanza
break. The extractor reports these rather than inventing text; the replacements
below were supplied by the maintainer from the original hymns.
Kept separate from the extracted text so re-running scripts/extract-hymns.mjs
never loses them. `stanza` and `line` are 1-based positions; a leading tab in
`text` marks the book's indentation, exactly as in the extracted data.
This file is only for restoring text the printing omitted. It is not a place
to correct the hymnal's wording — where the book differs from a hymn's more

155.note: Watts, 'How condescending and how kind'; omitted in the 32nd edition.

197.text: By all the wonders ye shall do.
197.note: Watts, 'Go preach my gospel, saith the Lord'; omitted in the 32nd edition. No closing quote — stanzas 1 and 3 both open a quotation mark and never close one, so the whole hymn is one continuous, unclosed speech; a lone closing mark here would break that pattern.
